verdict.rationale: The evidence documents individual payout capabilities: stablecoin payouts to Connect accounts, Global Payouts to external wallets, and payouts to third parties in 160+ countries. Nothing shows a batch or bulk payout API that submits many payouts in one documented operation with per-item status. Single-payout features are adjacent to this story and do not deliver mass disbursement.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can run mass disbursements — batch or bulk payout APIs that push many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one documented operation with per-item status
